question: At the reverie rev hermit builds today, does test.detcore_misc's vfork::vfork_parent_resumes_after_child_exec still hang under concurrent co-running, and at what rate?

subject.reverie_source: detcore/Cargo.toml rev=, NOT the parent submodule gitlink

positive_calibrator.label: zhead
positive_calibrator.role: a wave counts ONLY if this hangs at least once; otherwise the wave was under-powered and is discarded

negative_control.label: aclean
negative_control.role: proves the probe is not simply timing everything out

probe.deviation: stray reaping is per-process-group (bash monitor mode, kill -- -PGID on groups this script created) instead of `pkill -9 -x <basename>`, which Hard Invariant 15 forbids on this shared box; measurement semantics unchanged

power_caveat: The calibrator returned 3.98% where the SAME binary was recorded at 16.3%, because ambient load was 24-54 vs the original's 286-590. Detection power is roughly a quarter of the original's, so the absolute rate is an under-estimate; rely on the load-matched comparison against both controls in the same waves.
verdict: The current pin has returned to the CLEAN baseline, not to zero. cur is statistically indistinguishable from the historically-clean commit (p=1.000) and ~65x below the historically-flaky one (p=9.7e-19). detcore_misc is no longer in the flaky regime and is safe to co-run on this evidence. reverie PR #355 (820b2b64) is still NOT an ancestor of 3494609, so the outcome improved by some other means; the mechanism was not identified here.
retracts: The 'test.detcore_misc is the one node with evidence-backed need for exclusion' finding of task p0-is-validate-box-exclusivity-a-hardware-requirement-or-a-default.
still_open: kvm resource cap (2 privileged nodes, 124.4s) is unmeasured, not cleared
privileged-e2e.manifest_applications runs at 67.3% of its 130s wall budget (1.5x headroom) and is now the leading blocker to co-tenancy
